name: The Meeker household at 1815 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_meeker_arthur

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 1815 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 1815 Mr. & Mrs. Arthur Meeker.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 1815, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. In 1900 Levi Mayer lived here, not the Meekers. The census says nothing about this household's staff. The 1910 census (T624 roll 241, ED 166 and 167) was read for this card's children: the children it lists, and those the Blue Book lists at the number from 1890 to 1911, are on the card with the years each lived here, whether or not they were at home in 1904. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

occupation.note: Wikipedia's article on his son calls the father an executive of Armour & Co., retired in 1928; it does not date the post, so 1904 is inferred.

portrait_research.note: An individual portrait has not yet been verified in the period portrait books and Glessner House Museum article archive searched for this project. Any figure shown is a reconstruction, not an attested likeness.

persons.name: Arthur Meeker jr.

born.note: Born in Chicago on 3 November 1902 (Wikipedia); the later novelist of Prairie Avenue.

persons.note: A child of twenty months on the scene date. Wikipedia says 'the family lived on Prairie Avenue' without a number; the Blue Book puts his parents at 1815, so his place here is inferred from theirs. He had three sisters, whom the article does not name or date, so they are not on this card.

persons.name: Katherine Meeker

born.note: The 1910 census gives age 16 on 15 April 1910, so born about 1893-1894.

persons.note: The eldest of Arthur Jr.'s three sisters, whom his biography mentions without naming. The 1910 census lists her at 1815 aged 16, with her sisters Grace and Mary and her brother, and their mother as having borne four children, all living (ED 167, sheet 6B, lines 82-87). The family is listed here from the 1903 edition, so she was very likely about ten and at home in 1904; that is inferred, not recorded.
